meta.title: About us: purpose, values and culture | Intello
meta.description: Who we are: the operational extension of logistics companies. Our purpose, the S.H.O.W. values and the culture of the Success Team.

header.title: Built around ownership.
header.lede: We are not a logistics company: we are the operational extension of logistics companies. We run their processes with method, quality and visibility, so they can focus on growing.

essence.title: No old-school mission and vision.
essence.lede: Everything at Intello is built around success. Not only the company's, and not only in money: the success of everything we touch.

purpose.quote: Boost success, one process at a time.
purpose.text: We drive success one process at a time. It is why we exist, and it holds our team culture together.

motto.text: The drive behind everything we do. Wherever Intello gets involved, things must end up better.

values.title: Our people
values.titleAccent: are the stars of the show
values.lede: Performance has two meanings here: shining on stage and delivering results. Four actionable values set how we work.

items.title: Simplicity
items.text: The fastest, most mindful and efficient way to the best possible result. Once there, start again.
items.how: clear, repeatable processes that are easy to run.

items.title: Hyper-productivity
items.text: Do more, do it techy. Work smarter with technology, not harder.
items.how: we automate the repetitive so each person delivers more.

items.title: Ownership
items.text: Be responsible, reliable, proactive and passionate. Make it yours.

items.title: Wowly-done
items.text: Go beyond, be creative and live for the wow.
items.how: clients become fans of how we work, not just satisfied.

culture.title: A culture we practice,
culture.lede: We call our team the Success Team. These are the practices we use to help it grow, and the reason the person who learns your process is still there.

items.title: RISE
items.text: Reach your goals. Inspire others. Strive every day. Excel in life. Recognition and development with a quarterly fund shared by the active team.

items.title: Idea rallies with a prize
items.text: The best improvement idea wins the Better Now, with a bonus. Proposals go through team leads and Technovation, who confirm they can be applied.

items.title: Monthly Learning Sessions
items.text: Every month the team meets to learn and to reflect as a remote team.

items.title: Courses Intello pays for
items.text: Training beyond the monthly sessions, with courses paid directly by the company.

items.title: Success Architect
items.text: A person dedicated to coaching those who will grow. Roles that open up are filled from within.

items.title: Bizneo
items.text: Evaluations, training and tracking of each person's growth.

community.title: Viva Engage
community.text: Our internal community: where we live our values and see each other as people, with our wins and our lives, not just roles.

clients.title: Logistics companies
clients.titleAccent: with processes that can run remotely

direction.title: Where we
direction.lede: We are building our strategy with the Scaling Up method. These are the capabilities we are investing in over the coming years.

items.title: First-class onboarding
items.text: Process mapping and a standardized onboarding for new clients.

items.title: Technology and QA at scale
items.text: More automation and a dedicated compliance and quality team.

items.title: SOC 2 Type II certification
items.text: Certified security, availability and processing integrity. We will publish it here once it is certified.
